ov: Eight-armed molluscs, about 300 species, with three hearts and copper-based blood. Over 500 million neurons, about as many as a dog, and two-thirds of them are in the arms.

why.dg: All octopuses are venomous, but only the blue-ringed octopuses are known to be deadly to people.
why.et: Eaten and considered a delicacy in many places, especially around the Mediterranean and in Asia.

df: A predator of crabs and other crustaceans, clams, snails, fish and other cephalopods, taken back to its den to eat.
fx: Octopuses live only up to about four years, and some species’ life cycles finish in under a year.

_cf.tip: A squid has eight arms plus two long tentacles and a small internal “pen” for support. An octopus has eight arms and no tentacles.
